status: closed: Image/Shape/Line are application-owned windowless content and Timer is nonvisual; no product change
method: Read-only review of the frozen 148-unit matrix, fixed VB5/VB6 form sources, and prior native runtime60 MadShow window inventory. No private VB object inspection, desktop interaction, UAC, injection of user processes, IDE/OCX registration, or application data operation.

source_examples: VB5/VB6 XP Styles frmTestControls: VB.Image imgTest
PhotoAlbum VB form: multiple VB.Image declarations
image.ownership: The runtime draws image pixels, stretch, transparency, border and Click behavior through its host canvas. There is no independently verified HWND/public native control contract.

source_examples: VB6 Mastermind Form1: many VB.Shape declarations
shape_line.ownership: Geometry, fill, pen width/style and color are application drawing. Replacing them would change program-owned graphics rather than apply a system control style.

timer.runtime60_observation: MadShow exposes ThunderRT6Timer with style 0x44010000, WS_EX_CLIENTEDGE and size 0,0; it was deliberately not attached by the prior native probe.
timer.ownership: Interval, enabled state, callback timing and lifetime are program behavior; the helper window is not a user-visible Timer UI.

decision: Preserve all eight units as native application content/nonvisual behavior. Do not attach a painter merely because the containing Form or PictureBox is attached. Existing PictureBox/PictureBoxDC synchronous text scope remains the only separately proven container path and does not authorize Image/Shape/Line replacement.
verification: The negative decision is checked by frozen matrix rows, fixed source declarations and the prior native runtime60 timer inventory. No display/UAC condition is needed to establish the absence of a public visual HWND contract, so no unavailable desktop result was treated as blocking.
remaining: This is not a claim that every parent container is fully styled. Visual data/OLE, UserControl/MDI hosts, complex PictureBox drawing, graphical choice picture/default variants, extension OCX controls and final 148-unit audit remain in later T17 S tasks.
